outcome.title: Build the reproducible minimal-module fixture against live platform APIs
outcome.bounded: Checkpoint B produces one non-shipping fixture that restores, builds, and tests cleanly against live public platform APIs; it does not calculate or decide SM-2.

rollback.boundary: remove only the frozen fixture, fixture proof generator, validator, results, generated proof, and Story 11.2 record; retain Story 11.1.
